svg.title: Slingshot — planning a cryosleep over the long coast
svg.desc: Planning mockup (Living universe LU2): Planet X orbits the sun; its future track, a ghost at burn 2 and under the cursor, each tied to the path sample at the same moment, and the arrival ghost with its capture radius where the path ends.
